_about: Stable & Temple (levels 10-27): Brynn keeps the Royal Stables above; under them giant tunnel rats in the dusty and endless tunnels, skeletal guards still at their posts in the old temple's hallways, and in the Monster's Lair Grubbak the stable troll, who has been dragging the horses down.

3294.description: A long-hafted bronze blade gone green with age, the temple's sunburst cast into the socket.

3295.room_desc: A tarnished holy symbol lies here.
3295.description: A sunburst of silver on a broken chain, the old temple's sign. Whoever prayed to it is long forgotten.

3296.room_desc: A nibbled sack of oats lies here.
3296.description: A small sack of the royal stables' oats, gnawed open at one corner. It is still good to eat, boiled.

3297.room_desc: A huge club of bone lies here.
3297.description: The thighbone of a great warhorse, cracked and bound with rusted harness iron. It is as heavy as a man.

3298.room_desc: A matted cloak of horse blankets lies here.
3298.description: Royal stable blankets in faded blue and gold, stitched crudely together with gut into something a troll could wear. It stinks, but it is thick.

3280.name: rat giant tunnel
3280.long_desc: A giant tunnel rat scrabbles through the dust, its whiskers twitching.
3280.description: A rat the size of a dog, grown fat on oats stolen from the stables above and on whatever the thing in the lair leaves behind.

3281.name: skeleton temple guard skeletal
3281.long_desc: A skeletal temple guard stands its watch in the forgotten hallway.
3281.description: Bones in a corroded bronze hauberk, a glaive still gripped in its fingers. It kept its post when the temple was abandoned, and it keeps it still.

3290.name: grubbak troll stable
3290.long_desc: Grubbak the stable troll crouches in its den of stolen blankets, gnawing a horse bone.
3290.description: A hulking, warty troll with grey-green hide and a rank smell of the midden. For years it has dug up under the Royal Stables to drag horses down into the dark, and the grooms blame the wolves.

phases.message: Grubbak bellows and tears at the walls of its den, and earth rains down!

abilities.name: Bone Club Smash
abilities.telegraph: Grubbak heaves its horse-bone club high overhead!

abilities.name: Den Collapse
abilities.telegraph: Grubbak slams its shoulder into the den roof!

bosses.why: Grubbak the stable troll in the inner Monster's Lair, the den it dug up under the Royal Stables
